import re

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path="~/documents/work/meetings_files/", entry_type='files')
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Pattern: date__filename.ext
    match = re.match(r'^(.+?)__(.+?)\.([^.]+)$', filename)
    if match:
        date_part = match.group(1)
        file_name = match.group(2)
        ext = match.group(3)
        # Create directory for file_name
        dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{file_name}/"
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
        # Destination file path
        dest_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{file_name}/{date_part}.{ext}"
        # Move file
        result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
        print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {result}")
    else:
        print(f"Skipping {file_path} - not matching pattern")
